digest.component_or_area: bug creation and detection channel metadata
propositions: Environment variable REBAR_DETECTED_BY must be read at ticket creation seam (create_core) and stamped as detected_by field on the event; explicit --detected-by flag overrides env; absence of both leaves field unset.

Normalization is strip() + lowercase; empty or whitespace-only normalized values are treated as unset (field absent); unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without enum enforcement; create never fails on validation.

The detected_by field must be projected additively into compiled state via process_create only when present, mirroring source_*/creation_channel blocks; events without the field must reduce byte-identically to pre-change state.
The optional detected_by string field must be declared in ticket_state.schema.json compiled-state schema and registered in env-var/docs registry.

The feature must apply uniformly across CLI, library (_lib_writes), and MCP (_mcp_writes) create paths but intentionally exclude Jira inbound reconciler (apply_inbound_records.py) to avoid mis-attribution of reconciler daemon env.
